title: Juicy Sweet Japanese Apple Salad
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring sweet and juicy apples in a cider vinegar dressing, perfect for a light lunch or snack.

ingredients.name: Jalapeno Peppers, Finely Chopped (optional)
ingredients.notes: For a spicy kick, add jalapenos to taste.

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated Parmesan cheese, cider vinegar, apple cider, finely chopped jalapeno peppers (if using), lemon juice, honey or molasses, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Mix well until all ingredients are combined and evenly distributed.
Add sliced apples to the dressing mixture and gently toss to coat each piece of apple with the dressing. Ensure not to overmix as you want a juicy texture.
Let it sit for at least 10 minutes before serving, allowing flavors to meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature. Enjoy this Japanese-inspired dish on its own or alongside other light lunch items.
